consumer: An engine quantity-threshold predicate over the avatar's carried inventory asking 'does the tally of water_clean reach 250?', as computed by a charge-aware has_amount/charges_of-style call (the tally shape shown in amount_of_internal), whose boolean result is EVALUATED, not shown.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), counting charges for the count-by-charges item water_clean, against the required quantity 250 (not 1, not a nearby/map reach).
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<T>::has_amount / amount_of_internal — tallies matching items via visit_items up to a limit and returns whether the tally reached qty; this is the threshold-predicate authority (but it counts item entries, not charges, so for count_by_charges water a charges_of-style tally is needed for the 250 reach).
divergence: The avatar holds a single canteen containing exactly 250 charges of water_clean: a charge-blind item-entry tally (or the quantity-1 check in condition.cpp) reports the wrong quantity, while the correct charge-aware predicate at scope 250 returns true.
